scope: Only native identity and specified endpoints; not all move acceptance.

victory.observation: Actual original winner character after P2 KO. Kyo/Kim final HUD says PLAYER 2 LOST; own victory gesture remains visible; no next-round identity change.
victory.limitations: This is a round-win sequence after repeated ordinary C. It is not verification of every individual C variant or all win poses.
